responsibility: This file translates Fortran expressions and assignments from gfc_expr form into GCC trees during lowering. It handles scalar and array-valued expression conversion, character-length and descriptor creation, class/coarray component access, optional temporaries, scalarization-driven assignment fallback, and optimized special cases such as zeroing arrays, whole-array copies, array-constructor initialization, and array-function results; its output is the tree expressions and statement blocks consumed by statement translators and procedure-body generation.
